name: Semantics-Controlled Gaussian Splatting
definition: A method that separates 3D Gaussians into segmentation classes by directly assigning class IDs to each Gaussian in 3D space, altering the Gaussian rasterization process to allow classification in both 2D image space and 3D Gaussian space.
summary: Semantics-Controlled Gaussian Splatting integrates semantic segmentation into 3D Gaussian Splatting by assigning class IDs to Gaussians, enabling accurate large-scale object removal without feature-based ambiguity.
